turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Nadia. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My account has been frozen for eleven days and nobody will tell me why.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can see a security hold. Let me check the reason code.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Eleven days. My mortgage payment bounced because of this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The hold came from a fraud review. I don't have the detail on my side.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: So nobody can tell me anything? I'm speaking to a lawyer about this.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand your frustration. Let me escalate to the fraud team directly.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Do that. And I want it in writing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm requesting a written explanation and a callback within twenty-four hours.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Twenty-four hours. Then I'm filing a complaint with the regulator.

action_items: Escalate hold review to fraud team
Provide written explanation within twenty-four hours
